hook: How far one break-in can reach before it hits a wall.
definition: How much one failure or break-in can reach. Railway says its storage is designed so one compromised key cannot expose the whole platform.
example: Railway encrypts each environment's variables with its own key. After its breach, it said at most 1.85% of workspaces could have had variables decrypted.
the_catch: It is not a count of victims. Railway's 1.85% was an upper bound, because its logs identify environments, not individual variables.
caption: Blast radius is how much one failure or break-in can reach. Railway says its storage is designed so one compromised key cannot expose the whole platform, and that at most 1.85% of workspaces had variables decrypted. Would you rather one big lock or many small ones?
alt_text: A glossary carousel defining blast radius: how much one failure or break-in can reach, an example from an earlier gummietech post about Railway's breach, and the common mistake of reading it as a count of victims.
attribution: Railway, “Incident Report: October 21st Security Attack”, 10 Nov 2026

es.hook: Hasta dónde puede llegar una intrusión antes de chocar con una barrera
es.definition: Hasta qué punto puede llegar una falla o una intrusión. Railway afirma que su almacenamiento está diseñado para que una clave comprometida no pueda exponer toda la plataforma.
es.example: Railway cifra las variables de cada entorno con una clave propia. Tras la brecha, indicó que como máximo el 1,85 % de los espacios de trabajo podrían haber tenido sus variables descifradas.
es.the_catch: No se trata de un recuento de víctimas. El 1,85 % que reportó Railway es una cota superior, porque sus registros identifican entornos, no variables individuales.
